name: Cream Caron ~Bishoujo Kenshi Aimitsu Kyousei Kyuuin~
original_name: くりぃむキャロン～美少女剣士 愛蜜強制吸引～
source:
Couple months have passed since the battle with Ramo.
To rescue girls who are captured at dark castle, Caron sneaks into the castle.
However, a terrible trap awaits.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ051590.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
与拉莫的战斗已经过去几个月了。
为了营救在黑暗城堡中被俘虏的女孩，卡隆潜入了城堡。
然而，一个可怕的陷阱正在等待着。
